title: SendRRData explicit request to Quality of Service Object
purpose: Exercise explicit-message routing to the documented Quality of Service Object class with a compact GetAttributeSingle-style request shape for parser entry-point diversity.
expected_behavior: Parser should accept the encapsulation and CPF framing and forward the embedded explicit request toward object-class handling for the Quality of Service Object path.

Referenced documented CIP object class id 0x48 for Quality of Service Object.

Embedded path segments 0x20 class, 0x24 instance, and 0x30 attribute are conservative CIP prior assumptions, not directly verified in the supplied sources.

issue_safety_notes: No issue hypothesis is claimed; this seed is a structure-preserving parser-coverage candidate.
